Can you describe exactly how your cough feels, and does it produce any mucus? If so, what color is the mucus and how much do you cough up?

REQUEST TEST: Chest_XRay

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of lungs. Flattened diaphragm. No focal lung opacities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD). The chest X-ray findings of hyperinflation and a flattened diaphragm are classic signs of emphysema or chronic bronchitis, and the absence of focal opacities makes pneumonia less likely.
